name: The Revelry Suit

source.note: Fool's Day prize or heirloom; the book's numbers, our words.

magic.curse: The suit wants to dance. As each fight begins, make a Wisdom save (DC 0, 2 higher each time you use its magic, at most once a Long Rest) or spend your first turn dancing: Incapacitated, Speed 0.

summary: A suit of motley hide in the troupe's colours: +2 to Armor Class. Dancing Dodge (once a dusk, a failed Dexterity save succeeds while you can move) and Wild Steps (a Bonus Action to dance your Speed without Opportunity Attacks). Cursed: each fight may open with a dance you can't stop, and the suit's magic makes it harder to resist.

powers.name: Wild Steps
powers.text: Dance up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

powers.name: Dancing Dodge
powers.text: A failed Dexterity save succeeds while your Speed isn't 0.

powers.name: The suit's tune
powers.text: Counts the curse's growth (once a Long Rest).
